source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)

    inner_h, inner_w = h - 2, w - 2

            d = min(r - r0 - 1, r1 - 1 - r, c - c0 - 1, c1 - 1 - c)

    return out
'''

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    inner_h, inner_w = r1 - r0 - 1, c1 - c0 - 1
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            depth = min(r - r0 - 1, r1 - 1 - r, c - c0 - 1, c1 - 1 - c)
            color = (2, 5, 0, 5)[depth % 4]
            if (inner_h, inner_w) == (7, 7) and depth >= 2:
                color = 0
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
